svg.title: TCP buys reliability with round trips
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “TCP buys reliability with round trips” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch with client and server timelines and the three-way handshake drawn as crossing arrows labelled SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK with a circled measured cost of 22.6 milliseconds, then four data segments where the second is crossed out in red mid-flight, a duplicate acknowledgement returns and the segment is retransmitted in green while everything behind it stalls; a bandwidth-delay-product pipe worked out as 1.22 megabytes in flight; and two lower panels showing a thousand small TCP sends coalescing into 413 differently sized reads against UDP datagrams drawn as sealed envelopes that keep their boundaries but two of which are crossed out as lost.
svg.text: TCP buys reliability with round trips
draw it from memory, then compare
